formalLaws: NO_UNSCOPED_PASS: evidence is exact-source and consumer bounded
NO_BLIND_RETIRE: deletions require an explicit unique-source/effect-preservation witness
NO_AUTHORITY_BY_DISCOVERY: registry, Skill or Tool discovery never grants permissions
EFFECT_COMPOSITION: authority, shared state and irreversible effects are checked along the full consumer graph
STOP_SEMANTICS: detection, request to stop, actual process-tree termination, and effect reconciliation are independent

issues.observation: Local main and protected remote main diverge; 2300 local-only and 313 remote-only commits at observation.
issues.evidence: git merge-base main origin/main; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main
issues.decision: Consumer-based patch/merge comparison; never force-reset protected main.
issues.formalObligation: The selected source must be an explicit source cut and each chosen change must preserve owner CDC.
issues.consumers: Git source, CI, all downstream consumers

issues.observation: 51 local and 163 remote-tracking branches exist; branch count alone does not prove redundancy.
issues.decision: Retire only branches fully reachable from canonical main or with verified zero unique consumers/evidence.
issues.formalObligation: Retire(b) implies all unique commits/effects/evidence are reachable elsewhere.

issues.observation: 17 Linux Runtime Workspaces and one Windows Runtime Workspace at first snapshot; Git reports 36 worktrees in core repo.
issues.decision: Close clean unheld workspaces only after source/Job/evidence and exact SourceStateDigest checks.
issues.formalObligation: Close(w) -> no active Job and no unique unpreserved source/effect evidence.

issues.observation: 18 open PR: 3 conflicts (#211 #139 #27); four failing checks (#224 #218 #162 #139).
issues.decision: Compare overlapping changes by owner CDC; select one best implementation per consumer.
issues.formalObligation: Merge(p) requires compatible protected base, required CI and semantic consumer acceptance.
issues.consumers: Repo CI, runtime, web, game, security

issues.observation: PR #224 verification-entry.test.ts fails when /bin/sh executes 'set -o pipefail'; actual exit 2, expected 29.
issues.evidence: GitHub Actions run 40020297819, failing test at test/verification-entry.test.ts:52
issues.decision: Reuse and repair PR #224; explicitly select compatible shell and verify exit-code propagation.
issues.formalObligation: ShellInterpreter(script) supports every used shell option; failure oracle is preserved.

issues.observation: Last 100 workflow runs: 71 success, 7 failure, 22 cancellation; cancellations cannot all be classified as bugs.
issues.decision: Investigate genuine failure signatures and expected concurrency cancellation separately.
issues.formalObligation: RunCancelled != RunFailed; CI pass must be scoped to selected revision and consumers.

issues.observation: Six open Dependabot PRs (#207 #206 #205 #203 #202 #5); update grouping, lock alignment and consumer tests need source-specific qualification.
issues.decision: Choose newer supported stable versions on affected natural owners, not wholesale version-string bumping.
issues.formalObligation: Upgrade requires lock consistency, owner tests, vulnerable regression negative tests where applicable.

issues.observation: Existing H03 ActionAdmission and H04 EffectBinding declare boundaries; no current cross-service transitive authority experiment was run.
issues.decision: Register HS2 verification slice; do not claim H03/H04 implementation is broken.
issues.formalObligation: EffectiveAuthority(composition) subset of authorized authority; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.

issues.observation: Security S01-S05 and Agent Security AS/XAS lens exist; empirical path proof needs requalification.
issues.decision: Register SS2 consumer-qualified effect composition; no new policy engine.
issues.formalObligation: LocalSafety(A) and LocalSafety(B) do not alone establish Safety(A ∘ B).

issues.observation: Network N02-N04 list observations and fault acceptance; current cross-node transitive egress evidence was not executed in this audit.
issues.decision: Register NS2; run indirect DNS/proxy/monitoring service probes in isolated scenario.
issues.formalObligation: ObservedEgress is bounded by declared consumer policy after simulated inner-layer failure.

issues.observation: Green unit tests and executed Runtime jobs do not alone demonstrate domain semantic success; targeted real consumer Golden Path coverage not enumerated here.
issues.decision: Reuse owner CDC, replay, failure injection and trajectory evaluation; inventory real consumer calls.
issues.formalObligation: CompletedEffect -> independently observed domain result or UNKNOWN.

issues.observation: Shared timing/cache and cross-run noninterference require multi-trace proofs beyond single-run event logging.
issues.evidence: OpenAI frontier training environment 2026-10-23; existing Agent Security information-flow lens
issues.decision: Scope strong isolation to untrusted workloads/secret-bearing consumers before expensive hardware tests.

issues.observation: Native Ordivon, Matt and ECC Skills were discoverable; installation is not proof of task execution or applicability.
issues.decision: Select one task-relevant approved skill at a time; verify resulting owner effect.

issues.observation: New open PR #231 fails root-verification for owner-universe-bound convergence plans; this observation does not establish the exact failing assertion.
issues.evidence: gh pr view/checks 231; GitHub Actions run 40028281009; files: tools/repo/affected_owners.py, tools/repo/convergence_plan.py, tools/repo/test_convergence_plan.py
issues.decision: Fix in existing PR #231; do not fork duplicate owner-universe checker.
issues.formalObligation: ConvergenceOwnerSet(plan) subset of DeclaredOwnerUniverse(sourceCut), with strict unknown-owner rejection.
issues.consumers: Repository CI, affected-owner selection, merge queue
